Bea (marketing): hey @Luca quick ask for the launch post + webinar: we want a tiny validation pack that covers methodology + a short rerun for an odd tail case. specifically: 1) warmed prefix (prime 1500 tokens) vs cold baseline 2) one microburst (40 rps for 30s) 3) quantized variant comparison (fp16 vs int8-llm). need CSV percentiles + 5 raw outputs per cell and a 1-line PASS/FAIL against acceptance. can runtime take this?

Luca (runtime): yep. what exactly is your acceptance criteria so we can include it in the runbook?

Bea (marketing): acceptance: warmed p95 <= 330ms OR warmed p95 <= 1.3x cold p95 (whichever is stricter). during the burst <=1.5% requests >600ms. for quantized: p95 increase <= 1.4x vs fp16. if any check fails well fall back to conservative copy. need artifacts by EOD+1.

Zoe (eng-runtime): plan: small matrix. cold: 500 independent seq=1536; warmed: 350 primed traces prime=1500 + 6 followups; burst: warmed int8-llm at 40rps for 30s. variants: fp16, int8-llm. hardware: single A100 80GB. outputs: trace CSV (model,variant,cohort,latency_ms,status,seed), percentile summary, 5 jsonl raw examples per cell, and a runbook listing configs. estimate ~70-90m.

Bea (marketing): perfect. also include a short note in the runbook about whether weights were kept hot between variant runs. we prefer warm weights.

Luca (runtime): we'll warm weights between variants and separate the cache scenarios as "cold" vs "warmed". sample invocations well run: ```bash
# cold
curl -s -X POST https://bench.internal/run -d '{"model":"hero-launch","variant":"fp16","requests":500,"seq":1536}'
# warmed
curl -s -X POST https://bench.internal/run -d '{"model":"hero-launch","variant":"int8-llm","prime":1500,"followups":6,"requests":350,"traces":true}'
# burst
curl -s -X POST https://bench.internal/run -d '{"model":"hero-launch","variant":"int8-llm","prime":1500,"followups":6,"burst_rps":40,"burst_dur_s":30}'
```

Sam (product): can you attach 5 raw outputs each cell and a tiny automatic diff vs baseline (ROUGE-lite) so we can spot large regressions? if metrics spike we may ask for a reproducible 5k run.

Zoe (eng-runtime): will include 5 jsonl samples per cell and a small quality check. if quantized p95 > 1.4x we trigger an automatic repro with fixed seed and 5k samples to rule out sampling noise.

Bea (marketing): thanks. small editorial ask: mark one warmed sample per variant as "docs-safe" (strip internal links/IDs) so docs can grab a screenshot.

metrics-bot: bench-job-2212345678 queued by Luca at 2026-03-22T09:10:00Z

Luca (runtime): kicking off now. will post artifacts + 1-line PASS/FAIL here when done. if timing tight we can accept morning+1 but prefer EOD+1.

Bea (marketing): great — appreciate it. will hold headline text until you confirm PASS. :raised_hands:
